themes.name: Digital City Access
themes.rule: Includes municipal digital services, help accessing them, public internet connectivity, unified service-request channels, and publication of city data.

themes.name: Housing Affordability and Supply
themes.rule: Includes measures that create affordable homes, add or convert housing, or make rental prices and housing markets more transparent.

themes.name: Cultural Access and Arts
themes.rule: Includes public cultural events, museums, libraries, and commissioning or displaying visual art, but not instructional programs for pupils.

themes.name: School Learning Support
themes.rule: Includes school facilities, teacher workforce measures, classroom conditions, meals, tutoring, and educational instruction for children.

themes.name: Green Neighborhood Spaces
themes.rule: Includes parks, playgrounds, street trees, dog areas, and shared gardens that provide accessible neighborhood outdoor space or recreation.

themes.name: Environmental Sustainability Systems
themes.rule: Includes renewable energy, energy-efficiency upgrades, pollution monitoring, plastic reduction, recycling, and composting systems.

themes.name: Jobs and Small Business
themes.rule: Includes worker retraining, local hiring, coworking, business licensing reform, and finance for local businesses.

themes.name: Transit and Street Mobility
themes.rule: Includes public-transit fares, routes, frequency, rider information, cycling infrastructure, and physical traffic-calming measures.

themes.name: Healthcare and Home Care
themes.rule: Includes preventive screening, medical appointment access, primary care, mental-health treatment, and in-home support for older residents.

themes.name: Neighborhood Safety and Response
themes.rule: Includes crime prevention, community policing, emergency-response stations, and lighting intended to improve personal safety in public places.
